content: If DcmDspReadDTCInformationSupportedObdUdsDtc- Separation is set to False, the Dcm service processor for all diagnostic requests according to SAE J1979-2 shall use the Dem API Dem_SelectDTC with the parameter DTCFormat set to DEM_DTC_FORMAT_UDS to query and process DTC related information.

If DcmDspReadDTCInformationSupportedObdUdsDtc- Separation is set to False, the Dcm service processor for all diagnostic requests according to SAE J1979-2 shall use the Dem API Dem_SelectDTC with the parameter DTCFormat set to DEM_DTC_FORMAT_UDS to query and process DTC related information.
